scope: Preserve structured logging and existing health/error contracts; redact root password/currentPassword/newPassword/csrfToken in addition to the existing one-level and header paths.

red.command: npm test -- --run server/test/logging.test.ts in owned copied template
red.result: Actual app logger stdout contains all four synthetic authentication values at the log root while the nested fields are redacted.

controls: Real child loads the actual app/logger; capture actual JSON stdout, require no synthetic secret value, require retained safe field and structured severity/message, require exact root/nested redaction. Identity req/res serializers ensure the header redaction paths are genuinely exercised rather than silently dropping the objects.

Actual HTTP injection checks health without a run token, fresh server-owned correlation IDs despite a caller header, exact 404/500 problem objects and absence of unexpected Error/SQL/stack internals. Existing platform tests retain validation, security-header and configured run-token assertions.

Kernel scaffold and complete loan feature candidate runs require exact 103 neutral and 136 evolved application cases, plus existing 12/16 real browser cases, types and lint. No test population is skipped.

finalSource.method: Sorted unique git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z -- packages tools plugin; hash path+NUL+bytes+NUL.

supportedNode24.dependencyRestoration: Initial run explicitly failed SQLite ABI147 versus137. Rebuild only the owned scratch SQLite dependency for Node24, then both actual-app controls pass. Root dependencies are untouched.

privacy.scope: Actual tracked unstaged added lines and complete new files; no staging.
privacy.findings: Two credential-assignment heuristic matches on logging.test.ts lines30-31 are the literal expected censor output [redacted], not credentials. Both reviewed and dispositioned as false positives; no plaintext credential value is introduced.
privacy.limits: Heuristic scanning and this disposition are not exhaustive secret detection.

limitations: Named root/one-level/header fields only, not arbitrary nesting or secret text in messages/URLs/errors. Hardening notes disclose log access/retention duties. No exhaustive secret detection, ASVS conformance, independent/native review, workload rerun or whole-application qualification.
actionsNotTaken: No new dependency, kernel mechanism/schema/budget/target change, native spike, installed-host campaign, commit, push, branch, worktree or release.
